verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented capability for AI-generated component tests derived from a component's inputs or signal state. It shows only adjacent items: general 'AI-forward resources' and prompts, an llms.txt file, `ng test` for running unit tests, and schematic-based file generation, none of which is AI test generation from props or reactive state.

support.subject: As an ai-native developer, I can have AI generate component-level tests based on the props and reactive state my component declares
